data.review_body:
I am extremely frustrated and disappointed with Shein’s so-called "customer service".
I placed an order more than a week ago. The money was successfully debited from my account. After that, I was forced into an endless verification hell. They kept asking me to send proof of payment again and again — screenshots, transaction records, etc. Every time they replied that the documents were "unclear" or "incomplete" and sent me new verification links.
I did everything they asked, multiple times. And what was the final result? Today they suddenly informed me that they are issuing a refund.
My question is: Why did you make me waste over a week sending you proof of payment if you could clearly see in your system that the money had already been received? What was the point of all this nonsense?
This is not fraud protection. This is pure disrespect and time-wasting. I had to chase them every single day, send documents repeatedly, and deal with generic replies. Absolutely terrible service.
If something goes wrong with your order at Shein — be prepared for stress, endless requests, and in the end, most likely a refund after wasting your time.
I do not recommend shopping here at all.


UPD: Just received yet another useless canned response from Shein support that has zero connection to reality.
I sent them around 10 different proofs of payment (screenshots of the transaction, bank statements, etc.), all perfectly matching their requirements. The money was clearly received on their end from day one, yet they kept demanding more documents, claiming everything was "unclear" or "incomplete".
Now they’re refunding the order while pretending they “couldn’t verify authorization.” If the payment went through, what the hell else did they need? This wasn’t security — it was pointless time-wasting and disrespect.
Avoid Shein. The stress isn’t worth it.
data.review_headline: Absolute Circus – Wasted Over a Week of My Time for Nothing

data.owner_reply:
SHEIN takes product safety extremely seriously and is committed to offering safe and compliant products to our customers.

All vendors on our platform are required to comply with SHEIN’s code of conduct, safety standards, and all applicable laws. We partner with internationally recognised testing and quality-assurance agencies—including Bureau Veritas, Intertek, QIMA, SGS and TÜV SÜD—to help ensure that non-compliant products do not appear on our site. Where issues are identified, we take immediate action, which can include removing products or off-boarding vendors.

SHEIN additionally conducts randomized testing of products on our sites. If a product is deemed to be a compliance risk, or if any claims are made against a product, it is removed globally from our sites within 24 hours as a matter of caution whilst SHEIN conducts investigations. If non-compliance is verified, we do not hesitate to take appropriate follow-up action.

SHEIN endeavours to work closely with local product safety agencies, monitoring changes and developments of product safety compliance laws and regulations, and continuously invests and optimizes our product compliance processes.

In addtion, SHEIN has strategically invested, to intensify and expand initiatives for compliance management, carrying out millions of product and quality tests within the year.
